variants.prompt: This young woman exudes confidence lounging on a plush yacht deck at sunset, tousled chestnut hair and emerald eyes glistening in the golden hour light. A barely-there red bikini hugs her curves as she reclines on a cushion, statement gold jewelry glinting. The surrounding deck, with its sleek white railings and teak flooring, stretches out in a shallow focus with soft bokeh, capturing her relaxed yet assertive posture and the hint of vulnerability in her sparkling eyes.
